questions.stem: A swimming pool tallies the batch 55, 55, 57; what total does it print?

questions.stem: A recycling depot arranges 10 distinct items in a row; how many orderings (10 factorial) are printed?
questions.explanation: 10! is the product of the integers from 1 up to 10, which equals 3628800; that is the number of possible orderings printed.
